# What we are trying to build

## Chains of models lose the uncertainty

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- Every arrow between models is a handover, and uncertainty is
  approximated at each one
- The UK Community Infection Survey ran this way. Outside modellers saw
  summarised prevalence estimates
- Fitting the streams together avoids the handovers. Each model still
  gets written from scratch
- We want the components to be reusable, not the model

::: {.callout-note}
The argument for joint models is the 16:45 talk in this room.
:::
